notes: 1 Maccabees aligns very cleanly between Arabic source Arabic and English English — 12 of 16 chapters are verse-count-identical. The 4 divergent chapters all show ar > en by 1-3 verses, caused by Vulgate splitting a single LXX verse into two for narrative emphasis (e.g. ch1 v63 split into ar v65-66; ch12 v53 quotation split into ar v53-54).
ch1 v65-66 are the famous martyrs-rather-than-eat-unclean verses, immediately preceding the introduction of Mattathias. Vulgate gave them their own verse numbering for emphasis.
